from appium.webdriver.common.appiumby import AppiumBy
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID,'Joplin').click()
WebDriverWait(driver,10).until(lambda d: d.current_package != 'com.google.android.apps.nexuslauncher')
pkg=driver.current_package
act=driver.current_activity
root=ET.fromstring(driver.page_source)
items=[]
for e in root.iter():
 a=e.attrib
 if a.get('text') or a.get('content-desc') or a.get('resource-id'):
  items.append({k:a.get(k) for k in ('class','text','content-desc','resource-id','clickable','scrollable','bounds') if a.get(k)})
{'package':pkg,'activity':act,'elements':items[:100]}
